rocknix-mini: a ROCKNIX tree cut down for thimsy-import's tests.

Every file below imitates the ROCKNIX file at the same path in
https://github.com/ROCKNIX/distribution at commit 0f4806b59bfd1d3e6b17e3a632e95ced82a28719
(branch next, 2026-11-24), the shapes the importer was built against. Files marked "copy"
are byte copies (CRLF undone); "cut" files keep ROCKNIX's lines verbatim with the rest
removed; "written" files follow the real shape with made-up or reduced content.
ROCKNIX is GPL-2.0 (some files GPL-2.0-or-later, Apache-2.0 or BSD as their headers say);
these fixtures carry the same licences.

scripts/unpack                                                         cut (patch loop only)
projects/ROCKNIX/options                                               cut
projects/ROCKNIX/config.xml                                            cut (H700 rg40xx-h in DDR4 and DDR3; RK3566 Generic ARC-D, ARC-S)
projects/ROCKNIX/packages/linux/package.mk                             cut (three case branches, the RK3566 and H700 blocks)
